title: Implement bounded context packet and simple exact retrieval

implementation.bounded_packets: ContextPlanner rebuilds C0/C1 projections per invocation with separate ceilings for mandatory controller/task/state/output-schema content, routed evidence, tool schemas, and tool/failure synopses; unused budget is not backfilled with unrelated evidence.
implementation.stable_order: Weak-model packet order is controller prefix, relevant tool schema, task contract, current state, direct C1 evidence, routed expansion, tool/failure synopsis, then typed output schema.
implementation.exact_retrieval: ExactRetriever performs current path reads, bounded stable literal search, and current Git diff retrieval without embeddings or semantic indexes; stale expected file hashes fail closed and may then be deliberately refreshed.
implementation.provenance_and_dedup: Evidence items carry source/content digests, provenance/trust/routing metadata, repository locators, token costs, and digest-based duplicate removal.
implementation.expansion: Budget truncation emits source-bound expansion handles; compressed tool evidence exposes retained CAS expansion handles rather than raw logs in the model packet.
implementation.mode_exclusions: Full repository dumps, conversation/prior-attempt transcripts, raw tool logs, and hidden reasoning are excluded by default. Repair mode keeps current diff/failure/implicated evidence; reviewer mode excludes implementer reasoning trajectory.

verification.cargo_test_sovereign_context_repo_offlin: passed: 9 context packet + 5 repo baseline + 3 exact retrieval
